view.name: west_gate_closed_sign
view.purpose: New ordinary upper landing approach view; does not replace existing original/step views

findings: Header fits its real existing beam and is visible, but dark-on-dark letters lack a reliable reading contrast at the original arrival distance.
Closed west-gate phrase has substantial physical glyph height, but receives little direct light on its outward face and competes with background machinery through glass.
Geometry, backing and sweep pass; source previews do not satisfy the actual normal-presentation reading gate.
next_gate: Bounded actual Godot view under unchanged production lighting/presentation after source retention, if parent approves. If unreadable, propose a genuinely supported local-source revision; no hidden fill or global shader change.
